info.name: Zehire API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Zehire Backend.

## Setup

1. Set the `base_url` variable to your environment (default: `http://localhost:8787`)
2. Use **Auth > Login** to initiate magic link login
3. Check your email and copy the token from the magic link
4. Use **Auth > Callback** with the token - JWT will be auto-saved
5. All authenticated endpoints will use the saved JWT automatically

## Variables

- `base_url`: API base URL
- `jwt_token`: JWT token (auto-saved after callback)
- `job_id`: Current job ID for testing
- `public_slug`: Public job slug for testing
- `draft_id`: Application draft ID (auto-saved)
- `resume_token`: Draft resume token (auto-saved)
- `application_id`: Application ID for testing

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Magic link authentication endpoints.

**Flow:**
1. POST /auth/login with email
2. Check email for magic link
3. GET /auth/callback with token (or copy token from email)
4. JWT is auto-saved to collection variable

request.description:
Initiate magic link login.

**Response:** 204 No Content on success (email sent)

Check your email for the magic link with token.

console.log('JWT token saved to collection variable');

request.description:

**Steps:**
1. Copy the token from the magic link in your email
2. Replace `PASTE_TOKEN_HERE` with the actual token
3. Send request
4. JWT will be auto-saved to `jwt_token` collection variable

**Response:** User info with session cookie

Get current authenticated user info.

Requires valid JWT token.

Clear session cookie.

item.name: Jobs
item.description:
Job management endpoints.

All endpoints require JWT authentication.

**Job Lifecycle:**
```
draft → published → paused → closed
         ↑___________|
              resume
```

**Questions Status:**
- none: Not generated
- pending: Queued
- processing: LLM running
- completed: Ready
- failed: Error

**Pipeline Status:**
- none: Not generated
- pending: Queued
- processing: LLM running
- completed: Ready
- failed: Error

**Note:** Both questions AND pipeline must be completed before publishing.

request.description:
List jobs for the authenticated organization.

Supports cursor-based pagination.

exec: // Auto-save job ID for subsequent requests

request.description:
Create a new job as draft.

Does NOT automatically queue for question generation.

**Required fields:**
- title (3-200 chars)
- description: Tiptap JSON document (50-30000 chars extracted text)
- workType: remote, hybrid, onsite
- employmentType: fulltime, parttime, contract, internship

**Optional fields:**
- companyName (max 200 chars)
- department (max 100 chars)
- location (max 200 chars)
- salaryMin (non-negative number)
- salaryMax (>= salaryMin)
- salaryCurrency: USD, EUR, GBP, SGD, IDR

**Tiptap allowed nodes:** doc, paragraph, text, heading, bulletList, orderedList, listItem, blockquote, codeBlock, hardBreak, horizontalRule

**Tiptap allowed marks:** bold, italic, underline, strike, code, link (https only)

Get job status and details.

Response varies by job status (draft includes full editing data, published includes publicSlug).

Update a draft job's content.

**Note:** If `title` or `description` changes, questions and pipeline are reset to `none` and must be regenerated.

Only draft jobs can be updated.

**All fields are optional.**

**Description Format:** Tiptap JSON document with allowed nodes: doc, paragraph, text, heading, bulletList, orderedList, listItem, blockquote, codeBlock, hardBreak, horizontalRule. Allowed marks: bold, italic, underline, strike, code, link.

Delete a draft job.

Only draft jobs can be deleted. Published/paused/closed jobs must be closed and remain for records.

item.name: Lifecycle Actions
item.description:
Job lifecycle management endpoints.

**Flow:**
1. Create draft
2. Generate questions
3. Generate pipeline
4. Publish (starts billing)
5. Pause/Resume as needed
6. Close when done

request.description:
Queue a job for question generation.

**Rate Limits:**
- Maximum 20 regenerations per job
- 1 minute cooldown between regenerations

**Response:** 202 Accepted with `{ "queued": true }`

Poll GET /v1/jobs/:id to check questionsStatus.

Queue a job for pipeline generation.

Pipeline includes:
- Assessment recommendations
- Interview panel structure
- Evaluation criteria

**Rate Limits:**
- Maximum 20 regenerations per job
- 1 minute cooldown between regenerations

**Response:** 202 Accepted with `{ "queued": true }`

Poll GET /v1/jobs/:id to check pipelineStatus.

Get pipeline recommendation and configuration.

Returns:
- pipelineStatus: Current status
- recommendation: LLM-generated recommendation (read-only)
- config: Editable configuration (built from interview_stages table + assessment_config)
- generatedAt: When pipeline was generated

If pipeline not yet generated, recommendation and config will be null.

**Data Sources:**
- Interview stages from `interview_stages` table
- Assessment config from `jobs.assessment_config` column

Update pipeline configuration.

**Editing by Job Status:**
- `draft`: Structure only (assessment, stages name/duration/focus)
- `published`/`paused`: Operations only (interviewerIds, mode)
- `closed`: No edits allowed

**Interview Modes (published/paused only):**
- `any_one`: Any one assigned interviewer must be available (default)
- `all_required`: All assigned interviewers must be available

**Why this separation?**
- Draft = design the interview process
- Published = assign real people to conduct interviews

**Prerequisites:**
- Pipeline must be `completed`

All fields are optional for partial updates.

Reset pipeline configuration to AI recommendation.

This reverts any customizations and regenerates the initial config from the existing recommendation.

**Benefits:**
- No LLM call - instant response
- No token cost - free
- Doesn't count against regeneration limit
- Deterministic - same config from same recommendation

**Prerequisites:**
- Job must be in `draft` status
- Pipeline must be `completed`

Publish a draft job.

**Prerequisites:**
- Job must be in `draft` status
- Questions must be `completed` (questionsStatus)
- Pipeline must be `completed` (pipelineStatus)

**Effects:**
- Generates public slug
- Starts billing
- Job becomes publicly accessible

Pause a published job.

**Effects:**
- Hides job from public view
- Can be resumed later

**Note:** Pausing does NOT stop billing - paused jobs are still considered 'active' because Zehire is on the hook for candidate evaluations. To stop billing, close the job.

Resume a paused job.

**Effects:**
- Makes job public again
- Accepts new applications

**Note:** Billing continues unchanged - both paused and published jobs count as active.

Close a job permanently.

**Effects:**
- Job can no longer accept applications
- Cannot be reopened
- Billing stops

item.name: Custom Questions
item.description:
Custom questions for job applications.

**Question Categories:**
- `evaluative`: Free-text questions that extract signals (affects posture)
- `screening`: Pass/fail questions with expected answers
- `logistical`: Data collection questions (salary expectations, start date, etc.)

**Note:** Custom questions can only be added to draft jobs.

request.description:
List all custom questions for a job.

Returns questions ordered by `orderIndex`.

body.raw:
{
  "category": "evaluative",
  "answerType": "free_text",
  "questionText": "Describe a situation where you had to push back on a stakeholder's request. What was the outcome?",
  "required": true,
  "targetSignals": ["stakeholder_management", "communication_clarity", "accountability"]
}

request.description:
Create an evaluative custom question.

**Evaluative questions:**
- Must be `free_text` answer type
- Can map to target signals for extraction
- Affects Decision Posture

**Target Signals (choose 1-5):**
- decision_under_uncertainty
- tradeoff_awareness
- risk_reasoning
- ethical_awareness
- technical_depth
- system_thinking
- communication_clarity
- stakeholder_management
- accountability
- learning_from_failure

body.raw:
{
  "category": "screening",
  "answerType": "yes_no",
  "questionText": "Do you have authorization to work in the United States?",
  "required": true,
  "expectedAnswer": "yes",
  "failAction": "flag"
}

request.description:
Create a screening question.

**Screening questions:**
- Answer types: `yes_no` or `single_choice`
- Must specify `expectedAnswer`
- Does NOT affect Decision Posture

**Fail Actions:**
- `flag`: Flag application for review (default)
- `reject`: Auto-reject application
- `allow`: Allow with warning

body.raw:
{
  "category": "screening",
  "answerType": "single_choice",
  "questionText": "What is your highest level of education?",
  "required": true,
  "options": ["High School", "Bachelor's Degree", "Master's Degree", "PhD"],
  "expectedAnswer": ["Bachelor's Degree", "Master's Degree", "PhD"],
  "failAction": "flag"
}

request.description:
Create a screening question with choices.

**Expected Answer:**
- Can be a single string or array of acceptable answers
- For choice questions, must match one of the options

body.raw:
{
  "category": "logistical",
  "answerType": "number",
  "questionText": "What is your expected annual salary (USD)?",
  "required": false,
  "minValue": 0,
  "maxValue": 1000000
}

request.description:
Create a logistical question.

**Logistical questions:**
- Answer types: `single_choice`, `multiple_choice`, `number`, `date`, `url`
- Does NOT affect Decision Posture
- Used for planning and coordination

**Number constraints:**
- `minValue`: Minimum allowed value
- `maxValue`: Maximum allowed value

body.raw:
{
  "category": "logistical",
  "answerType": "multiple_choice",
  "questionText": "Which office locations would work for you?",
  "required": true,
  "options": ["New York", "San Francisco", "Austin", "Remote"]
}

request.description:
Create a multiple choice logistical question.

Candidates can select multiple options.
Get a specific custom question by ID.

Update a custom question.

**Note:** Only draft jobs can have questions updated.

All fields are optional.

Delete a custom question.

**Note:** Only draft jobs can have questions deleted.

Deleting a question also deletes all associated answers.

Reorder custom questions.

Pass an array of question IDs in the desired order.

**Note:** Only draft jobs can have questions reordered.

Get AI-suggested signals for a question text.

**Use this before creating an evaluative question** to see which signals the question will evaluate.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "signals": ["decision_under_uncertainty", "risk_reasoning"],
  "confidence": "high",
  "reasoning": "This question evaluates..."
}
```

**Confidence levels:**
- `high`: Clear signal mapping
- `medium`: Reasonable mapping
- `low`: Weak or no clear mapping

item.name: Applications
item.description:
Application management endpoints for recruiters.

All endpoints require JWT authentication.

**Application Status Flow:**
```
pending → screening → assessment → interview → offer
                                              ↓
                                          rejected
```

**Triage Actions:**
- SHORTLIST: Strong candidate, prioritize
- MAYBE: Uncertain, needs more review
- WEAK: Weak signals, deprioritize

**Decision Postures:**
- LOW_REGRET_RISK: Strong signals, confident hire
- SOME_UNCERTAINTY: Mixed signals, proceed with caution
- HIGH_UNCERTAINTY: Weak signals, higher risk

exec: // Save first application ID if available

query.description: Filter: pending, screening, assessment, interview, offer, rejected, withdrawn
Sort field: createdAt, updatedAt, candidateName, posture

request.description:
List all applications for a job.

**Supports filtering by:**
- `status`: Application pipeline status
- `signalsStatus`: Signal extraction status
- `posture`: Decision posture (after signals computed)

**Pagination:**
- `limit`: Max results (1-100)
- `offset`: Skip first N results

**Sorting:**
- `sort`: createdAt, updatedAt, candidateName
- `order`: asc, desc

Get full application details including answers, extracted signals, and navigation context.

**Returns:**
- Candidate info (email, name, preferredName, phone)
- Auto-detected location (detectedCountry, detectedTimezone)
- CV status (hasCv, cvUrl)
- Application status and triage status
- Signal extraction status and results
- Decision posture
- All archetype answers with extracted signals per answer
- Custom answers with questions, values, and extracted signals (for evaluative)
- Navigation context (prevId, nextId, currentIndex, totalCount)

**customAnswers array:** Each entry includes:
- `id`, `questionId`, `questionText`: Answer and question identifiers
- `category`: `evaluative`, `screening`, or `logistical`
- `answerType`: `free_text`, `yes_no`, `single_choice`, `multiple_choice`, `number`, `date`, `url`
- `value`: Answer value (string, string[], number, or null based on type)
- `screeningPassed`: Boolean for screening questions (did answer match expected?)
- `extractedSignals`: Array of signals for evaluative questions (null for others)
- `extractionStatus`: `completed`, `pending`, `failed`, or `skipped`

**Note:** signalEvaluations and extractedSignals will be null until signal extraction completes.

**Navigation:** Sorted by posture (LOW_REGRET_RISK first) for quick review.

Update application status and/or triage status.

**Status values:**
- `pending` - Just submitted
- `screening` - Under initial review
- `assessment` - In assessment phase
- `interview` - Interview scheduled/in progress
- `offer` - Offer extended
- `rejected` - Rejected by recruiter
- `withdrawn` - Withdrawn by candidate

**Triage values:**
- `SHORTLIST` - Strong candidate, prioritize
- `MAYBE` - Uncertain, review later
- `WEAK` - Weak signals, deprioritize

At least one of `status` or `triageStatus` is required.

Quick triage action without changing pipeline status.

**Triage values:**
- `SHORTLIST` - Strong candidate, prioritize
- `MAYBE` - Uncertain, review later
- `WEAK` - Weak signals, deprioritize

Get the decision posture for an application.

**Returns when signals are computed:**
- `posture`: LOW_REGRET_RISK, SOME_UNCERTAINTY, or HIGH_UNCERTAINTY
- `primaryReason`: Human-readable explanation
- `reasons`: Array of all contributing reasons with severity
- `signals`: Object with present/partial/missing/criticalGaps arrays
- `conflicts`: Any detected contradictions
- `suggestedActions`: Recommended next steps for hiring manager

**Returns 202 when:**
- Signals not yet started
- Signals currently processing

**Returns 500 when:**
- Signal extraction failed

Download the CV file for an application.

**Returns:**
- Binary file stream
- Content-Type header (e.g., application/pdf)
- Content-Disposition header with filename

**Errors:**
- 404: Application not found
- 404: No CV uploaded for this application
- 404: CV file not found

Get all notes for an application.

Notes are ordered by creation date (newest first).

**Returns:**
- Array of notes with author info and content

Add a note to an application.

**Request body:**
- `content`: Note text (1-5000 characters)

**Note:** Notes are automatically associated with the authenticated user.

Delete a note.

**Authorization:** Only the author can delete their own notes.

**Returns:** 204 No Content on success.

Get activity timeline for an application.

**Event types:**
- `status_change`: Pipeline status changed
- `triage_change`: Triage status changed
- `note_added`: Note was added
- `note_deleted`: Note was deleted
- `signals_started`: Signal extraction started
- `signals_completed`: Signal extraction completed
- `signals_failed`: Signal extraction failed
- `cv_uploaded`: CV was uploaded

Events are ordered by creation date (newest first).

Get structured CV summary for an application.

**Returns:**
- `extractionStatus`: pending, processing, completed, failed, skipped
- `totalYearsExperience`: Number or null
- `hasManagementExperience`: Boolean
- `workExperiences`: Array of work history
  - id, title, company, startDate, endDate, isCurrent, durationMonths, highlights
- `education`: Array of education records
  - id, degree, field, institution, year
- `skills`: Array of skills
  - id, name, category (language, framework, tool, soft_skill, other)
- `gaps`: Array of detected career gaps
- `contradictions`: Array of CV vs answer contradictions (Phase 8D)

**Note:** CV must be uploaded and processed. Use `/cv/reprocess` to trigger processing.

Trigger CV reprocessing for an application.

Clears existing CV data and runs the extraction + summarization pipeline again.

**Use cases:**
- CV processing failed initially
- LLM model was updated
- CV summarization format changed

**Note:** This runs synchronously and may take a few seconds.

Send a scheduling invite to the candidate.

Creates a scheduling token and sends an email with a link to the candidate self-service scheduling portal.

**Request body:**
- `stageId`: The interview stage ID (e.g., "round_1", "technical_interview")

**Returns:**
- `success`: Boolean
- `schedulingLink`: The link sent to the candidate
- `expiresAt`: Token expiration (7 days from creation)
- `_magicLink`: (dev only) Direct link for testing

**Flow:**
1. Creates a scheduling token for the application + stage
2. Sends email to candidate with scheduling link
3. Logs "scheduling_invite_sent" event
4. Candidate uses /schedule/:token endpoints to book

item.name: Candidates
item.description:
Cross-application candidate lookup.

Enables recruiters to see all applications from the same email address across different jobs.

Look up all applications by a candidate email.

**Query parameters:**

**Returns:**

item.name: Public
item.description:
Public-facing endpoints for candidates.

No authentication required.

**Application Flow:**
1. GET job details to see questions
2. POST apply to submit (all answers required)
3. Optional: Use draft endpoints to save/resume progress

request.description:
Get public job details by slug for candidates.

**No authentication required.**

Only returns published jobs.

**Returns:**
- title, companyName, department, location
- workType, employmentType
- salaryMin, salaryMax, salaryCurrency
- descriptionHtml (pre-rendered HTML)
- questions: Array of archetype questions (archetypeId, text, minWords)
- **customQuestions**: Array of custom questions (Phase 8)
  - id, category, answerType, questionText, required
  - options (for choice types), minValue/maxValue (for number)
- **cvRequired**: Boolean indicating if CV upload is mandatory

Save application progress for later completion.

**No authentication required.**

Answers can be partial or empty - useful for Save & Continue feature.

**Response includes:**
- `draftId`: Unique draft identifier
- `resumeToken`: Secure token to resume (store this!)
- `expiresAt`: Draft expiry (7 days from creation)
- `progress`: How many questions answered

**Note:** Drafts are auto-deleted when application is submitted.

query.description: Resume token from save draft response

request.description:
Resume a previously saved application draft.

**No authentication required.**

**Query Parameters:**
- `token`: Resume token (required) - received from save draft response

Alternatively, send token in `X-Resume-Token` header.

**Returns:**
- `candidateEmail`: Saved email
- `candidateName`: Saved name
- `answers`: Array of saved answers
- `expiresAt`: When draft expires
- `progress`: Completion status

**Note:** Returns 404 if draft has expired (after 7 days).

formdata.description: CV file (PDF, DOC, or DOCX, max 5MB) - Optional

request.description:
Submit a complete job application.

**No authentication required.**

**Requires `multipart/form-data` content type.**

**All archetype questions must be answered** (minimum 50 characters each).

**Form fields:**
- `data`: JSON string with application data
  - `email`: Candidate's email (must be valid)
  - `name`: Candidate's full name
  - `preferredName`: Optional preferred name/nickname
  - `phone`: Optional phone number (may be required per job config)
  - `answers`: Array of archetype question answers
    - `archetypeId`: Question identifier (from job questions)
    - `answerText`: Answer text (min 50 chars)
  - `customAnswers`: Array of custom question answers (get question IDs from GET /public/jobs/:slug)
- `cv`: Optional CV file (PDF, DOC, or DOCX, max 5MB). Required if job has cvRequired=true.

**Custom Answer Value Types:**
| Answer Type | Value Format | Example |
|-------------|--------------|----------|
| `free_text` | string | `"My detailed answer (min 50 chars)..."` |
| `yes_no` | string | `"Yes"` or `"No"` |
| `single_choice` | string | `"Master's Degree"` (must match option) |
| `multiple_choice` | string[] | `["San Francisco", "Remote"]` |
| `number` | number | `120000` |
| `date` | string | `"2024-06-01"` (ISO format) |
| `url` | string | `"https://example.com"` |

**Example customAnswers:**
```json
[
  { "questionId": "eval_id", "value": "Long answer text..." },
  { "questionId": "yesno_id", "value": "Yes" },
  { "questionId": "choice_id", "value": "Option A" },
  { "questionId": "number_id", "value": 120000 },
  { "questionId": "multi_id", "value": ["A", "B"] }
]
```

**Screening Questions:**
If the job has screening questions and answers don't match expected values:
- `failAction: 'flag'` → Application submitted with warning
- `failAction: 'reject'` → Application auto-rejected (returns success: false)
- `failAction: 'allow'` → Application submitted normally

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "applicationId": "app_xyz789",
  "message": "Your application has been submitted successfully",
  "cv": { "filename": "resume.pdf", "size": 245760 },
  "screeningWarning": true // Only if screening flagged
}
```

**Auto-detected fields:** Country and timezone are automatically detected via Cloudflare.

**Duplicate Prevention:** Returns 409 if email has already applied to this job.

item.name: Billing
item.description:
Billing and usage endpoints.

All endpoints require JWT authentication.

**Billing Model:**
- $200/month per active role
- Prorated by milliseconds
- Calendar month billing periods
- Active = published OR paused

request.description:
Get current month usage summary.

Returns:
- Period dates
- Per-job active time breakdown
- Total active job-days
- Billing waiver status

Preview of current charges up to now.

Shows what you would be charged if the billing period ended right now.

Useful for real-time cost tracking.

Get usage for a specific month.

**Path Parameters:**
- year: 2020-2100
- month: 1-12

Example: `/v1/billing/2026/1` for January 2026

Get invoice for a specific month.

**Path Parameters:**
- year: 2020-2100
- month: 1-12

Returns:
- Line items with job details
- Prorated amounts
- Subtotal, discount, total
- Formatted currency strings

**Note:** Cannot generate invoices for future periods.

item.name: Capacity
item.description:
Organization capacity endpoints.

Get capacity status for various resources.

**Currently Available:**
- jobs: Active roles capacity (published + paused jobs)

**Future:**
- users: Team member capacity
- candidates: Candidate pool capacity

request.description:
Get organization capacity status.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "jobs": {
    "activeRoles": 2,
    "capacity": 3,
    "isOverCapacity": false,
    "canActivate": true
  }
}
```

**Fields:**
- `activeRoles`: Count of published + paused jobs
- `capacity`: Maximum allowed active roles
- `isOverCapacity`: True if activeRoles > capacity (soft warning)
- `canActivate`: True if a new role can be published
